name: forkhead box R2

function.text: FOXR2 encodes forkhead box protein R2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS neuroblastoma, FOXR2-activated. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
